tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Paper. The ground of the capture surface, the note page and the plain stream list. iOS: Color(.systemBackground). macOS: NSColor.textBackgroundColor. Never tint it; Knot's paper is the system's paper.

tokens.name: background-secondary
tokens.usage: Grouping inside paper: the ground of an inline notice and of the ink canvas frame. iOS: Color(.secondarySystemBackground). macOS: windowBackgroundColor, the window chrome around the sidebar.

tokens.name: background-grouped
tokens.usage: Settings only: the ground of a grouped Form. iOS: Color(.systemGroupedBackground). macOS: the Settings window background. Never used for notes or the stream.

tokens.name: background-grouped-cell
tokens.usage: Settings rows on background-grouped. iOS: Color(.secondarySystemGroupedBackground). macOS values approximate what .formStyle(.grouped) draws: the system paints it, never set it yourself.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: The capture sheet and popovers in dark appearance, where iOS lifts presented surfaces to #1c1c1e automatically. Do not paint it: present a .sheet and the system elevates it.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Ink. Every word a person wrote, stream titles, the capture field's text, all glyphs on toolbars. Reads on every background token in every theme (15:1 or more). SwiftUI: .primary.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata that supplements ink: stream previews, times, pending segment states, the append-window caption, provisional live transcript. System secondaryLabel, kept exact: 3.4:1 on background in iOS light and 4.0:1 on macOS light, below WCAG AA for small text (6.4:1 and 5.9:1 in dark). Never the only copy of something a person must read; Increase Contrast raises it. SwiftUI: .secondary.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text (“Type a thought”) and disabled rows only. System tertiaryLabel / placeholderText: 1.7:1, decorative by the platform's own rule; never for information. SwiftUI: .tertiary.

tokens.name: label-quaternary
tokens.usage: The unplayed bars of a voice segment's waveform. Nothing else. SwiftUI: .quaternary.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Track of the audio player's progress. iOS: Color(.systemFill). macOS: NSColor.systemFill (iOS values shown).

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a custom row (setup rows). iOS: secondarySystemFill. macOS: NSColor.secondarySystemFill (iOS values shown).

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Ground of an inline notice and of a selected segment while its context menu is open. iOS: tertiarySystemFill. macOS: NSColor.tertiarySystemFill (iOS values shown). Ink on it stays above 15:1.

tokens.name: fill-quaternary
tokens.usage: Hover on a segment (iPad pointer, Mac). iOS: quaternarySystemFill. macOS: NSColor.quaternarySystemFill (iOS values shown).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Between stream rows only, drawn by List. Never inside a note: segments are separated by space alone. iOS: Color(.separator). macOS: separatorColor.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Knot's tint is ink. AccentColor asset: #000000 Any, #FFFFFF Dark, same for Increase Contrast. Prominent glass buttons (Done), the arrived dot, the cursor, selection handles, the focused search field. On macOS it applies only when the person's accent is Multicolor; otherwise their accent wins, as it should.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Glyph or text on an accent fill: the checkmark in the prominent Done button. 21:1 on accent in iOS; 15:1 on macOS.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: The red dot: the only red Knot paints, and only while a microphone is live (starting, live, stopping). SwiftUI: Color.red. Increased contrast: #e9152d light, #ff6165 dark (the system supplies them). As a glyph on background: 3.6:1 light, 6.1:1 dark; never as text.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: The stop square on a record fill. 3.6:1 light, 3.4:1 dark: a glyph, never text. The live timer sits beside the control in label, not on red.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: “Needs you” only: the failed-step glyph and word, the stream row's failed mark. Asset “Attention”: light #C55300 (Apple's increased-contrast orange, used always so the word reads), dark #FF9230 (systemOrange). Text on background: 4.6:1 light, 9.4:1 dark. On background-secondary and macOS window grounds (3.9:1 to 4.1:1 light) use it for the glyph only.

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: The system's green, left untinted on Toggle in Settings so on/off reads at a glance; Knot never sets it. SwiftUI: Color.green. 2.2:1 on white, the platform's own pairing.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on iPad with a hardware keyboard: the system's focus effect, which follows the tint, so it draws in ink (solid, 21:1). On macOS the system ring in the person's accent; never draw your own.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: WEB PREVIEWS ONLY: a stand-in for Liquid Glass (regular) behind toolbars, the record control, the Mac capture panel and the undo capsule. In the apps never a colour: standard bars, .buttonStyle(.glass) or .glassEffect().

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: WEB PREVIEWS ONLY: the hairline rim of a glass stand-in. The system draws the real rim and its specular highlight.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Compact Rounded", "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: ios-large-title
styles.usage: Large Title. Emphasized (bold) as the stream's collapsing title “Notes”, which the system draws.

styles.name: ios-title1
styles.usage: Title 1. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: ios-title2
styles.usage: Title 2. Emphasized (bold) for a Markdown # line inside a note.

styles.name: ios-title3
styles.usage: Title 3. Emphasized (semibold) for a Markdown ## line inside a note.

styles.name: ios-headline
styles.usage: Headline. A stream row's title (the note's first line).
styles.sample: Call the roofer about the leak

styles.name: ios-body
styles.usage: Body. Everything a person writes: note text, the capture field, live transcript; Settings rows. Emphasized (semibold) for **bold**.
styles.sample: Ask for Thursday, before the rain comes back.

styles.name: ios-callout
styles.usage: Callout. The sentence of an inline notice.
styles.sample: This note was deleted on another device.

styles.name: ios-subheadline
styles.usage: Subhead. A stream row's preview of the latest segment, in label-secondary; first to go at accessibility sizes.
styles.sample: a scripted transcript of a recording

styles.name: ios-footnote
styles.usage: Footnote. A stream row's meta line, a segment's state line, the append-window caption, Settings footers. Emphasized (semibold) for “Needs you”.

styles.name: ios-caption1
styles.usage: Caption 1. The voice player's time, with monospaced digits.

styles.name: ios-caption2
styles.usage: Caption 2. The 11-point floor. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: mac-large-title
styles.usage: Large Title. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: mac-title1
styles.usage: Title 1. Emphasized (bold) for a Markdown # line inside a note.

styles.name: mac-title2
styles.usage: Title 2. The floating capture panel's field, so a thought lands large; emphasized (bold) for a Markdown ## line.
styles.sample: Call the roofer about the leak

styles.name: mac-title3
styles.usage: Title 3. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: mac-headline
styles.usage: Headline. A sidebar row's title.
styles.sample: Call the roofer about the leak

styles.name: mac-body
styles.usage: Body. Note text, Settings rows, menus. Emphasized (semibold) for **bold**.
styles.sample: Ask for Thursday, before the rain comes back.

styles.name: mac-callout
styles.usage: Callout. The sentence of an inline notice.
styles.sample: This note was deleted on another device.

styles.name: mac-subheadline
styles.usage: Subheadline. A sidebar row's preview and a segment's state line, in label-secondary.

styles.name: mac-footnote
styles.usage: Footnote. A sidebar row's time and kind glyphs; the 10-point floor.

styles.name: mac-caption1
styles.usage: Caption 1. The voice player's time, monospaced digits.

styles.name: mac-caption2
styles.usage: Caption 2. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: watch-large-title
styles.usage: Large Title. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: watch-title1
styles.usage: Title 1. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: watch-title2
styles.usage: Title 2. The live timer under the record control, monospaced digits.

styles.name: watch-title3
styles.usage: Title 3. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: watch-headline
styles.usage: Headline. The one-word outcome: Recording, Saved.

styles.name: watch-body
styles.usage: Body. An outcome sentence: “Too short. Nothing was kept.”

styles.name: watch-caption1
styles.usage: Caption 1. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: watch-caption2
styles.usage: Caption 2. Not used in Knot.

styles.name: watch-footnote1
styles.usage: Footnote 1. The second line of an outcome, in label-secondary: “Stopped at 30 minutes.”

styles.name: watch-footnote2
styles.usage: Footnote 2. Not used in Knot.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to text inside a meta line; between the kind glyphs of a stream row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Glyph to sentence in a notice; a segment's state line to its text; play button to waveform.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of an inline notice and the undo capsule; between the Mac panel's field and its control row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The compact layout margin (iPhone, iPad Slide Over): the system's, via safe area and contentMargins; never hard-code it.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The regular layout margin (iPad, Mac note page) and the Mac capture panel's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between two segments of a note. Space is the only divider a note has.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the capture field when the append window shows the note being added to; above the first segment under the toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: An ink segment's thumbnail in a stream row; the Mac sidebar selection (system-drawn).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The highlight behind a segment while its menu is open; the ink canvas frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: An inline notice in the content layer.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The Mac floating capture panel. Its inner field takes radius-xl minus space-5 (concentric); SwiftUI: ConcentricRectangle / containerShape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: glass buttons, the record control, search, the undo capsule, waveform bars, the player track.

size.note: Points in the apps, pixels here.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size on iPhone, iPad and Watch. Every glyph button, the record control, a setup row's dismiss.

tokens.name: hit-target-mac
tokens.usage: Minimum clickable size on the Mac: toolbar items and the panel's microphone.

tokens.name: record-control-watch
tokens.usage: Diameter of the record control on the Watch: two hit targets, centred, nothing else on screen.

tokens.name: readable-width
tokens.usage: Widest text column for a note on iPad and Mac at default text size: the system's readable content width; it grows with Dynamic Type.

tokens.name: mac-panel-width
tokens.usage: Width of the Mac floating capture panel; its height grows with the text up to half the screen.

tokens.name: waveform-bar
tokens.usage: Width of one waveform bar (and the gap between bars) in a voice segment.

shadow.note: Web stand-ins: in the apps the system draws every shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under a glass stand-in (toolbar, record control, undo capsule) in previews.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Under the Mac floating capture panel in previews; the real panel takes the system window shadow.
